text:
maria: Quick ask — drafting the internal blurb for tomorrow's micro-release. Can we agree on a compact layout that ops can copy into the deploy channel?

maria: Goal: 3 bullets (what, impact, action) + one short 'rollback criteria' line. Keep it <2 sentences per bullet.

tom: +1. Also include the image/emoji mapping for severity so comms folks don't guess. e.g. :sparkles: new feature, :bug: fixes, :warning: config changes

ellie: Draft I made below. Can someone sanity-check wording for SRE?

ellie: • What: Add prefix caching toggle to redis-backed inference cache (opt-in).
• Impact: ~10% lower p90 latency for medium requests when enabled. No DB migrations.
• Action: Deploy to staging; ops enable toggle for canary traffic only.

ellie: Rollback criteria: error rate > 0.5% or p95 regression > 15% after 30m.

maria: Nice. Suggest tighten 'impact' to concrete metric and one sentence for engineers. e.g., "~10% p90 improvement for seq len <=1024; no schema changes."

sanjay: Ops note: For rollout we want 5% canary for 30m, then 25% for 1h, then 100% if stable. Abort triggers listed. Add the canary steps under Action.

jamal: Also add the flag name and how to enable in console. Small sh snippet for deploybot would help.

ellie: Good point. Updated draft: 
• Action: /deploy staging --tag v2.14.0 --canary 5% then 25% then 100% (monitoring steps below). Toggle name: infra.cache.prefix_toggle

ellie: Code snippet for deploy channel (copyable):
```
/deploy --env staging --tag v2.14.0 --canary 5
# after 30m: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.14.0 --canary 25
# after 1h: /deploy --env prod --tag v2.14.0
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled job queued: tag=v2.14.0, env=staging, canary=5%. Use `/deploy status 1716171717` to follow live logs.

tom: Suggest we include the dashboard shortlinks for quick eyeballs (latency, errors, traces). I can paste the links if you want.

maria: Yes please. Add shortlinks and a one-liner for who owns oncall (SRE rotation name).

sanjay: Oncall: @sre-oncall. Dashboards: latency: https://dash.redwood/inference/p90 , errors: https://dash.redwood/inference/errors , traces: https://jaeger.redwood/service/inference

jamal: Also - tiny nit: spelling 'p90' lowercase is fine, but keep it consistent.

ellie: Finalized release-blurb (copy/paste for deploy channel):
"""
:sparkles: What: prefix caching toggle (infra.cache.prefix_toggle) — opt-in cache for short seqs.
:zap: Impact: ~10% p90 improvement for seq <=1024; no DB or schema changes.
:wrench: Action: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.14.0 --canary 5 (30m) -> 25 (1h) -> prod. Enable toggle via Console > Feature Flags > infra.cache.prefix_toggle.
:rotating_light: Rollback: enable rollback if error rate >0.5% or p95 regression >15% sustained for 30m.
:link: Dashboards: latency / errors / traces (links in thread).
:person_with_turban: Oncall: @sre-oncall
"""

maria: This is excellent. One more ask — legal wants one sentence about data access (none added). Add: "No new data collected; feature only touches cached inference traffic."

ellie: Added. Final copy below and I'll post at T-30m.

ellie: Posting note: "Will post to #deploys at 09:30 PT, then kick canary after green light from @sre-oncall."

tom: :thumbsup: Good to go. I'll paste the dashboard links and pin the message after deploy-bot posts the status.

sanjay: I'll be watching metrics and will call abort if thresholds breach.

deploy-bot: Deployment started (1716171717) -> staging canary 5%. Logs: https://logs.redwood/deploy/1716171717

maria: Thanks team — saved. Posting window T-30 now.
